title: PDF and slide images: Chinese, Japanese and Korean text is drawn as boxes without a system font for it
symptom: by default a system font draws the Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters the deck's embedded fonts and the bundled fonts lack (the bundled CJK faces hold a few characters only); on a machine with no such font, and always with bundled fonts only or from the deterministic helpers, the glyphs are empty boxes, and a diagnostic names the script, the number of characters and the way out
workaround: install a CJK font, or pass a CJK font file (CLI convert, render and thumbnail --font-dir; Python fonts=... or font_dir=...; Rust the *_with_diagnostics entries with font files)
